Threshold: Works in ≥ 2 of 4 vol regimes OR ≥ 1 regime with DSR ≥ 1.2
Why this number: Allows a "specialist" path: a single-regime strategy can pass if it's very good in that regime, because then you can gate it on regime detection.
Catches strategies that look great but have one bad trade hiding everything.
